summary: Full backend + frontend test of EditGuil portfolio. Backend: all 6 pytest cases pass (root health, contact CRUD, validation 422 on missing/invalid email, Mongo persistence, _id excluded, Resend email_sent=true). Frontend: page renders with Hero 'Guildwen Marot / EditGuil', all 6 required section anchors present, FAQ accordion toggles, contact form submits successfully (toast 'Message envoyé' + form reset), empty-form validation toast 'Merci de remplir' fires, mobile menu opens with all nav links. One minor testid mismatch found.

ui_bugs.issue: Play button data-testid is 'showreel-play-btn' but review_request/spec referenced 'showreel-play'. Functional, just a naming mismatch — toggle still works.

action_items: (Optional) Align Showreel play button data-testid with spec: rename 'showreel-play-btn' -> 'showreel-play' OR update spec docs.

(Optional) Move `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` definition above its first use in server.py (currently defined at line 147 after _send_email_async/create_contact reference it; works at runtime due to module-load order but is fragile).

(Optional) Note: Resend test mode only delivers to verified account email; email_sent=true confirms API acceptance but real delivery to guildwen.marot@gmail.com requires verified domain at resend.com.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py logger defined after functions that reference it — works because functions execute only after module load completes, but reorder for clarity.

Contact.jsx onSubmit uses HTML5 'required' on inputs, so the JS-level guard `if (!form.name||!form.email||!form.message) toast.error(...)` only fires when required attributes are bypassed; behavior is correct but redundant. Could rely on HTML5 OR remove required to surface custom toast.
No rate-limiting / spam protection on POST /api/contact — public endpoint can be abused; consider simple IP throttling or hCaptcha for production.
GET /api/contacts is unauthenticated — exposes all customer leads (PII). Add auth before going live.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_ prefixed contact via backend pytest and 1 via Playwright (both persisted to MongoDB contacts collection).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_contact_api.py. Run via: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_contact_api.py -v. Mongo collection 'contacts' will accumulate TEST_ rows — safe to ignore or clean. Resend deliverability is test-mode only.
